headline.purpose: Column headers (Goblins/Regular/Demons) and section labels rendered in genuine small-caps.

body.purpose: All reading text and every stat/odds/margin value, so number columns align.

label.purpose: Field labels, stat labels, dividers -- small-caps, tracked, sized above the 0.75rem accessibility floor.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Hover/focus state changes on inputs, buttons, and rows.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled-accent primary action; base `button` style inherited by 'Scan whole slate' and 'Log parlay'.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Scan whole slate for this date</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #e2572e; color: #17110b; border: 1px solid #e2572e; padding: 0.75rem 1.4rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, transform 80ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ec6b45; border-color: #ec6b45; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e2572e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; border: 1px solid #57503f; color: #b3a891; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.03em; padding: 0.5rem 0.95rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #0c0b0a; color: #ece6d8; border-color: #e2572e; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e2572e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tier Grade Box (S)
components.description: Signature component: tier signal as a bordered stamp, not a colored pill. S-tier variant shown; A/B/C swap border+text color, below/unknown/no-data swap border-style.
components.css: .ds-tier-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: Bevan, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 0.12rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid #57503f; color: #b3a891; text-align: center; min-width: 1.6em; } .ds-tier-s { border-color: #6f9a5d; color: #6f9a5d; background: #161c12; }

components.name: Wire-Service Badge
components.description: Bracketed status tag drawn with CSS-generated content instead of an icon or emoji, e.g. [EST +2pt], [CALIB], [CONFLICT].
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 0.1rem 0.15rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-badge::before { content: '['; } .ds-badge::after { content: ']'; } .ds-badge-est { color: #b3853f; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Date/text field: inset well background, hairline-strong border, no radius.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem; border: 1px solid #57503f; background: #0c0b0a; color: #ece6d8; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.88rem; transition: border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #8f8570; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #e2572e; }

components.name: Section Tab
components.description: Entry-builder tab: muted by default, 2px accent underline when active.
components.css: .ds-tab { background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; padding: 0.55rem 1rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.82rem; color: #8f8570; cursor: pointer; margin-bottom: -1px; } .ds-tab-active { border-bottom-color: #e2572e; color: #ece6d8; }

components.name: Small-Caps Column Header
components.description: Results-column header: display face, genuine small-caps on mixed-case text, 3px double rule.
components.css: .ds-column-header { font-family: Bevan, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.15rem; font-variant: small-caps; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #e2572e; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; padding-bottom: 0.5rem; border-bottom: 3px double #57503f; }

narrative.overview: PickKing reads as a reported agate box score, not a betting-app dashboard. The category default it explicitly refuses is neon/gradient sportsbook chrome, including the product's own prior look (a generic dark-elevated-card dashboard with a gold accent). In its place: a near-black newsprint ground, hairline column rules, a condensed slab-serif for headlines, a monospace numeral face for every stat so figures column up like a stat table, and small-caps tracked labels standing in for section heads. A leg is a line in a ledger; grading is a stamped grade box, not a gamified chip. This is a code-led build: no comp exists, so every value below is read directly from the shipped static/style.css and templates/page.html, not from the original direction contract's aspirations. Two disciplines named in that contract were deliberately not built and are not part of this system: LED-style lit/unlit state dots for 'live vs. stale' data, and a brief live-tile flip on a value that 'just moved.' Both assumed a live-polling/streaming data model; PickKing is a one-shot scan-and-render flow with no such state to indicate, so building either would have invented an affordance for a state that doesn't exist.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black "wire" ground with off-white ink and exactly one spot-color accent, used for primary actions and the masthead rule only.
Flat rectangles everywhere: no radius, no shadow, no gradient (one narrow, functional exception -- see Shapes).
Genuine small-caps (not uppercase text-transform) on every section label, tracked and tight.
A condensed slab-serif carries headlines and matchup titles; a monospace face carries every number and every line of body text.
Tier grade renders as a bordered inset box color-coded by tier, never a tinted card or colored pill.

rules.name: The One Spot-Color Rule
rules.body: The masthead accent is the only saturated color used for action and emphasis; status signal (hit/miss/caution) is carried by the separate green/crimson/brass triad, never by the accent.

rules.name: The Contrast-Is-Canonical Rule
rules.body: --accent, --danger, --warning, and --text-muted were each re-picked mid-build specifically to clear 4.5:1 contrast against --bg. Any future adjustment to these tokens must re-verify against that floor.

rules.name: The Genuine Small-Caps Rule
rules.body: Section and stat labels use font-variant: small-caps on real mixed-case source text, never text-transform: uppercase.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing in this system casts a shadow or uses a gradient. Depth comes from the raised/inset tonal pair and rule weight only.

dos: Do keep every number in the monospace face (--font) so stat/odds columns stay aligned; never substitute a proportional face for a value column.
Do use genuine font-variant: small-caps on real mixed-case text for section/stat labels -- not text-transform: uppercase.
Do render tier as a bordered grade-box keyed to the status triad (wire-green / accent / brass-warning / neutral), never as a filled colored pill or a tinted row background.

Do keep the masthead's 5px double accent rule and the results columns' 3px double header rule as the system's only two "heavy rule" moments -- they read as a print convention specifically because they're rare.
donts: Don't use emoji, icon fonts, or glyph icon sets anywhere in this system -- the sport <select> previously carried basketball/baseball/football emoji and they were removed as a craft-floor violation; badges draw their own CSS-generated brackets instead.
Don't add radius, shadow, or gradient to any surface -- the one permitted exception is the circular loading spinner, and it exists only because a spinner must be round.

Don't invent a live/stale state indicator (lit/unlit dots) or a "value just changed" flip animation for this app. Both were raised in the original direction contract and intentionally not built: PickKing's render is a one-shot scan/re-render, not a live data stream.
Don't give a secondary/outlined treatment to a primary call-to-action button; primary actions always inherit the base filled-accent button style.
